name: punyts
description: The development workspace for the punyts system: each library is its own repo, cloned here by bin/clone-repos.sh

scripts.setup: bash bin/clone-repos.sh && npm install && npm run build && npx playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell
scripts.build: bash bin/run-all.sh build && npm run build:runtime-bundle -w @punyts/stateui-app
scripts.mcp:build: bash bin/run-all.sh build core expression state state-sync stateui stateui-app stateui-components stateui-mcp && npm run build:runtime-bundle -w @punyts/stateui-app
